subject: Temporary invoice-only routing while vendor setup completes - Codesurge
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@codesurge.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@codesurge.io
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding / PO requirement question

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited to get Codesurge set up. Procurement at our side asked whether Redwood requires a purchase order for initial pilot invoices. Our internal process is slow and we need to bill for the first month to get the trial going.

Could we route invoices to your AP team without an active PO for the first 60 days while we finish the vendor setup? We can provide a signed W-9 and complete your onboarding questionnaire immediately (attached).

If a temporary invoice-only path is possible, please confirm any evidence you need and who on your end will sign off. If a PO is strictly required, tell us the earliest expected issuance timeline so we can align.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Finance Operations
Codesurge
--
Attachment: codesurge_onboarding_questionnaire.pdf (form, 6 pages)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@codesurge.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / PO requirement question

Hi Marta — great to hear and glad the demo was useful.

Short answer: we can often enable an interim invoice-only routing for pilots, but Procurement needs explicit evidence and a timebound approval from Finance.

What procurement will need from Codesurge to consider a temporary no-PO path:
- Completed onboarding questionnaire (got it — thanks)
- W-9 or equivalent tax ID doc (please attach signed PDF)
- Point of contact for billing questions at your side (name + phone)
- Confirmation that total monthly spend for pilot will be under $25k (so we can classify as small-engagement exception)

If you can send the signed W-9 and confirm spend range today, I will loop in Karthik (procurement) and Lauren (finance) to request a short-term invoice routing approval for up to 60 days. Approval typically includes: invoice-only routing to AP, invoice PDF to ap@redwood.com, and manual reconciliation.

I’ll initiate an internal request once we have those items.

—Mina
Mina Haddad

On Mon, Mar 15, 2026 at 11:03 AM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> If you can send the signed W-9 and confirm spend range today, I will loop in Karthik (procurement) and Lauren (finance) to request a short-term invoice routing approval for up to 60 days.

Thanks Mina — putting procurement viewpoint here.

We are open to a time-limited invoice-only routing for pilots, provided the vendor meets standard onboarding evidence and we capture a risk acceptance in our procurement ticket. The checklist I need attached to the request:
1) Signed W-9 (or equivalent) — required
2) Completed onboarding questionnaire — required
3) Primary billing contact and PO fallback owner at the vendor — required
4) Estimated monthly spend and pilot end date — required
5) Liability & data processing notes flagged if the pilot handles customer data — optional but will escalate if present

Operational notes:
- Approval will be a documented procurement exception (internal ticket) with a 60-day expiration; extension requires re-evaluation.
- Finance (Lauren) must approve the exception before AP processes invoices.
- If spend exceeds the estimate during the pilot, AP will pause payments until PO is in place.

Mina, if Codesurge sends the W-9 and confirms spend (<$25k/mo) I will prepare the exception request and draft the internal ticket. Priya, please flag any legal or DPA considerations if Codesurge processes any customer-identifiable data during the trial.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

On Mon, Mar 16, 2026 at 08:20 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Approval will be a documented procurement exception (internal ticket) with a 60-day expiration; extension requires re-evaluation.

Marta — thanks for submitting the questionnaire and the unsigned W-9 earlier. We still need the signed W-9 PDF to attach to the exception.

We’re comfortable approving a 60-day temporary invoice-only route with the following conditions:
- Signed W-9 received (attach to reply)
- Billing contact provided: full name, email, phone
- Pilot spend capped at $25,000 / month (notify us immediately if you expect to exceed)
- Invoices to be sent to ap@redwood.com with vendor invoice number and Redwood account reference (HG-2026-0884)
- Procurement exception ticket will be created and visible to Codesurge for transparency

If Codesurge agrees, please send the signed W-9 and billing contact by end of day tomorrow and we will issue the exception. After 60 days we will require a formal PO or an extension request approved by Finance + Procurement.

Regards,
